question: Sunita won (3)/(5) of the marbles that were there in the beginning of the game. Ravi won (2)/(3) of the remaining marbles while Sunny won the remaining 60 marbles. How many marbles did Sunita win?
solution:
Given:

Sunita won (3)/(5) of the marbles that were there in the beginning of the game.

Ravi won (2)/(3) of the remaining marbles while Sunny won the remaining 60 marbles.
